title: Chapter 1397
text:
On the other side, in the Supercluster Alliance Conference Room.

"Sanctum Revival … What a terrifying power. Hehe, the three Universal Civilizations are probably having a hard time right now."

Compared to the heavy atmosphere of the three Universal Civilizations' leaders, the Supercluster leaders were rather happy.

As the rulers of the explored universe, the three Universal Civilizations were hostile to all existences that could shake their rule. The Supercluster Alliance, on the other hand, hoped that some factors that could affect the current situation would appear.

Originally, Black Star had dragged the association to this point with a one-time Sanctum Revival. Now that the true effect of the Sanctum Revival was revealed, the Beyond Grade A Association became countless times more troublesome. The more unhappy the three Universal Civilizations were, the happier the Supercluster Alliance would be.

"Black Star has obtained an independent political position from the three Universal Civilizations, and the treatment he receives is quite high. With Black Star's methods and the power of the association, the galactic society might form a stable three-pole structure in the future. We, the three Universal Civilizations, and the association will balance each other. This is good news for us."

The Star Arc Civilization's leader pondered and said.

"It should be a pseudo-three-pole structure. We're still a little lacking compared to the three Universal Civilizations. However, the association has the Sanctum Revival, and we have a lot of resources. If we cooperate more closely, we won't have to be afraid of the suppression of the three Universal Civilizations. The galactic society will no longer be under their control," someone corrected with a smile.

One of the Modo Three Kings said in a muffled voice, "It's too early to say this. The premise is that the three Universal Civilizations win this war. Otherwise, it's all empty talk."

"That's true. We can't be happy too early with the enemy in front of us." Someone nodded in agreement.

This time, the Star Arc Civilization's leader knocked on the table.

"There are still about eleven years before the World Tree invades our territory. At that time, we'll see if we should evacuate from the explored universe. This time is enough for us to make preparations. Keep it a secret and don't let others know about our plan in advance."

Hearing this, everyone nodded.

The Supercluster Alliance had always been considering the possibility of using the war to migrate. This was a plan that had been decided long ago. During the interception circle war, they had secretly started to build secret stargates in their own civilizations to connect to the Supercluster Civilizations at the border. Once they started to migrate, they could directly reach the migration point from their own territory.

At the same time, under the excuse of taking refuge, most of the population had been gathered and managed. As long as the plan was activated, the migration would be highly efficient. In addition, a lot of resources had been secretly stored. Some shipyards directly under the Federation had been secretly producing long-distance starships during the interception circle war, preparing for the long-distance migration.

Everything was being prepared. The Supercluster Alliance's plan was to start after the World Tree invaded their territory. At that time, they would observe the battle and decide whether to run or not.

"If the three Universal Civilizations are defeated, Black Star's group will definitely not die with them. They'll definitely evacuate. By then, we might have a chance to take over the Beyond Grade A Association …"

Someone whispered softly.

The Star Arc Civilization's leader rubbed his fingers and shook his head. "Hmm, you can't say that. If we migrate to another area, we will become the new rulers. An existence like the association will also become a threat to us. Therefore, if the three Universal Civilizations explode, it's best if we don't have any contact with the association. It's not bad to live our own lives."

These words had the feeling of 'let's split up and go our separate ways. You go back to your Quicksand River, and I'll go back to my Gao Laozhuang'. Everyone present could not help but laugh.

Although everyone was envious of the association's Beyond Grade As and the Sanctum Revival channel, which was a powerful force to defend against foreign enemies, they knew that they would not have the chance to obtain these benefits.

The Supercluster Alliance did not have the confidence of the three Universal Civilizations, and they were even more afraid of the Beyond Grade A Association taking over. After all, their strength was weaker than the three Universal Civilizations. If they entered a migration period without legal restrictions, the Beyond Grade As who could continuously revive would have the power to overthrow their regime. Therefore, if everyone had to evacuate one day, parting ways would make them feel more at ease.

"Speaking of which, Black Star is really a talent. He successfully played the three Universal Civilizations once. The current situation has his shadow behind it. In just a few decades, the Beyond Grade As have such strength, breaking the rigid situation. It's not easy."

The Star Arc Civilization's leader sighed softly. His tone was filled with admiration and fear.

Although their relationship with Black Star often changed, from a personal point of view, the Star Arc Civilization's leader and most of the Supercluster leaders present mostly admired Black Star.

Everyone had carefully read Black Star's files. If they had not witnessed everything with their own eyes, they would not have been able to imagine that a country bumpkin from a surface civilization had only used a hundred years or so to rise from the bottom all the way to the top stage.

It was a pity that such a character was not born in their civilization. If not for the fact that Planet Aquamarine was protected by the black star, they would have dissected this planet to see why there were three Beyond Grade As on this planet. Furthermore, they were not ordinary Beyond Grade As. What was the probability of this happening?

The Star Arc Civilization's leader changed into a comfortable position and sighed. "I have no other hope for the association now. I just hope that they can sell us more revival slots … Speaking of which, there's no limit to the number of Sanctum Revivals. Will Black Star lower the price for us?"

Everyone tilted their heads and fell into deep thought.

…

In the training base, the Calamity Grade combat training ground.

Energy surged, and light flashed. Five figures surrounded Hadavy, and all sorts of attacks smashed onto his body, exploding into light fragments that filled the sky. They could only leave faint marks on his tough body, but they were unable to break through his defense.

The continuous sound of explosions was mixed with Hardaway's maniacal laughter.

"Hahahaha! It's useless, useless, useless! Your attacks don't hurt at all. They're much worse than His Excellency Black Star's Apostle Weapons. It's impossible to break through my defense! "

Just listening to his confident tone, it seemed like he was extremely brave, fighting one against five. However, upon closer inspection, the five Calamity Grades were beating Hardaway up like kicking a rubber ball.

In the spectator stands in the sky, many Calamity Grades looked down at the shaking training ground with strange expressions.

"He can still be so arrogant after being beaten up. Looks like he's learned the essence of an Army Commander."

"This guy is indeed a Black Star Guard who has followed His Excellency Black Star for decades. His tankiness is definitely from the same lineage."

Everyone chatted casually.

The Black Star Corps had once harvested hundreds of Beyond Grade A seeds, so most of the spectators were members of the army. However, they were not only there to watch the show but also to line up to beat Hardaway up.

After decades of training by Han Xiao, Hardaway's hardening Esper Ability had been developed to an astonishing level. He was used to being beaten up by Beyond Grade A Apostle Weapons, and normal Calamity Grades were already like tickles to him. Even slightly weaker Calamity Grades would not be able to break through his defense.

Therefore, Hardaway became the human punching bag of the training base. Many Calamity Grade students were willing to use him to test how far away they were from a Beyond Grade A. As long as they could beat Hardaway up, it would prove that they were half a step away from the Calamity Grade.

The beating continued for quite a while before the five attackers stopped. Hadavy immediately got up from the ground and pretended to pat the non-existent dust off his body. He waved his finger at the five of them and snorted with an expression that was asking for a beating.

"That's it? I don't feel anything yet. Let's train some more. Try to make me want to die next time. "

"Why do you always have to say such ambiguous words?" A Calamity Grade wiped his sweat and could not help but complain. "Is this the culture of your Black Star Corps?"

"If the upper beam is not straight, the lower beam will be crooked." Another person agreed.

Sylvia, who was participating in the attack, was unhappy and said to her companions, "You can play around, but don't make fun of my dear Army Commander."

Hearing this, Hardaway looked at her, patted his chest, and pretended to be disdainful.

"You quit your job as the Chief Administrative Official and have been training in seclusion for so long. Why haven't you improved much? I think you should stop training here. You definitely won't be able to become a Beyond Grade A."

Hearing this, Sylvia turned around with a look of disdain. "You have the cheek to say that? With your single ability, you'll be at the bottom of the Beyond Grade A."

"So what if I'm at the bottom? At least I have the ticket to eternal life."

Hardaway looked like a dead pig that was not afraid of boiling water. Ever since the truth of the Sanctum Revival was revealed, such words could no longer pierce his heart.

In order to enjoy the Sanctum Revival, he did not even play his favorite Wayne Cards. Lagi had called him several times, but he had reluctantly rejected him.

Speaking of which, the number of people playing cards had decreased by 99% recently. Only Lagi was still pulling people in, but the frequency had also decreased a lot. People would often see Lagi training in the magic training ground. His training time had increased by ten times compared to before! (Because of the low base.)

This was a rare sight that only appeared once in a decade. Many of the army officers who knew him were shocked and encouraged. They were all full of motivation.

Even Lagi is working hard. What right do you have to be lazy?

This time, a few more Calamity Grades jumped down from the sky and landed on the field.

"Alright, let's stop chatting. We're still queuing up. It's our turn. Hardaway, do you want to take a break?"

Hardaway patted his chest and said casually, "What break?

"What's there to rest for? These people are useless. I'm thirsty. Come, fight me!"

"I already said, don't be ambiguous!"

The group roared.

Just as the group of Calamity Grades were sparring, in the Psychic training room inside the training base, Feidin, who was immersed in training, suddenly opened his eyes, and a stream of light flashed in his eyes.

In that instant, he seemed to have broken through some invisible boundary. A tremor from the depths of his cells started from his brain and slowly spread throughout his body inch by inch. It was as if every cell was crying out in joy and desire.

Then, the cells in his body slowly became restless. Like water that was being heated, the temperature kept rising and gradually boiling.

"This feeling … I'm going to level up?"

Fu Ding was overjoyed. He would not be wrong about the feeling of his life evolving. Different from his previous Promotion, the feeling this time was dozens of times stronger, causing his body to tremble uncontrollably. His psychic energy also surged out uncontrollably, sweeping back and forth in the room like a storm.

At this moment, the Soul Swapper that he was carrying with him suddenly sensed something. It vibrated at a high frequency, and circles of faint black ripples spread out like ripples. When it touched the psychic power, it actually fused subtly. The psychic power that was originally as invisible and colorless as air seemed to have been drawn with a brush. Its edges were dyed black, and it showed a flowing trajectory.

Before Fu Ding could be shocked, he realized that his psychic energy seemed to have entered an unknown area. Countless voices from his soul swarmed over.

"Ah!"

Fu Ding screamed in pain, feeling as if his head was about to explode.

Amidst the pain, a piece of location information appeared in his mind. He realized that he had vaguely sensed an unknown existence, and a strong intuition was guiding him. The path to ascension was there.

It was a pity that Han Xiao did not see it at this time. Otherwise, he would have most likely lamented that a treasure that had been covered in dust had reappeared. He was very familiar with this path!

As expected of a child blessed by the heavens, even the Promotion mission was different. If they were there, he would definitely interview Fu Ding and ask him what it was like to be one of the three thousand faces of the Goddess of Luck.
